items.description: Validates user credentials and returns JWT token for authenticated access
business_logic_steps: 1. Validate ReCaptcha token to prevent bot attacks
2. Look up user by username in database
3. If user exists, authenticate credentials using Spring Security
4. Generate JWT token with user's username and roles
5. Return JWT response with token and user authorities
6. Handle validation failures with appropriate error messages

items.description: Creates new user account with validation and role assignment
preconditions: Username and email not already taken
business_logic_steps: 1. Validate ReCaptcha token for bot protection
2. Check if username already exists in database
3. Check if email is already registered
4. Encrypt password using BCrypt encoder
5. Create User entity with default ROLE_USER role
6. Save new user to database and return success message

items.description: Processes and validates JWT tokens for request authentication
preconditions: Authorization header with Bearer token present
postconditions: Security context established for valid tokens
Authentication details set in Spring Security context
business_logic_steps: 1. Extract JWT token from Authorization header
2. Validate token signature and expiration using JwtProvider
3. Extract username from validated token claims
4. Load user details from database via UserDetailsService
5. Create authentication token and set in security context
6. Continue filter chain for authenticated requests

items.description: Creates signed JWT tokens with user claims and expiration
postconditions: Token contains username and expiration claims
business_logic_steps: 1. Create JWT builder with username as subject
2. Set issued date to current timestamp
3. Calculate expiration time using configured duration
4. Sign token with HS512 algorithm and secret key
5. Compact and return the final JWT string
